title: Safety in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and summarizing studies that compare jailbreak attack success rates and the generation of unsafe or biased responses across different languages (e.g., English, Chinese, Spanish) to identify linguistic safety disparities.
Summarizing evaluations from culturally-specific benchmarks (e.g., CHiSafetyBench) to assess how models handle culturally-specific safety concerns and harmful prompts.
